issue.title: Arm the code-swap launch retry for sase prompt run
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-1tz.3.1.4 (swap_launch_guards, epic sase-1tz.3.1) as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #5; filed by the sase-1tz.3.1 land agent.

`src/sase/prompt/cli_run.py` (`sase prompt run`, `edit`, and `select`) launches through `sase.main.query_handler.launch_query`, which now carries the code-swap defer and retry hooks (`defer_launch_for_code_swap` and `retry_launch_after_code_swap` in `src/sase/main/query_handler/_launch.py`). However, `sase.main.entry._arm_launch_swap_retry` (`src/sase/main/entry.py:127-136`) arms only `sase run` and `sase bead work`. The re-exec is therefore a no-op for prompt replays, which keep today's fail-on-skew behavior.

Caveat: the retry re-execs the same argv, which is safe for `sase prompt run <selector>` but would re-open the editor or the fzf picker for `sase prompt run --edit`, `sase prompt edit`, and `sase prompt select`. Either arm only non-interactive `prompt run`, or make the replay re-exec with the resolved prompt text after the interactive step. Extend `tests/main/test_entry_launch_swap_retry.py`.

task_type_fields.proposal: Arm arm_code_swap_retry for non-interactive sase prompt run in sase.main.entry._arm_launch_swap_retry (or re-exec with resolved prompt text after interactive edit/select), with entry tests.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1tz.3.1 named sase run, epic launch, sase bead work, and runner start; prompt replay needs an interactive-mode design decision.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1tz.3.1.4 (swap_launch_guards): prompt replays go through launch_query's defer/retry hooks but entry never arms them, so they still fail on swap skew.
